$comment: AUTHORITY for what a Worker service asks a model to answer in (WORKER-SERVICE.md § The request, § The five kinds of mark job): the JSON Schema of one element of the array a detection asks for. `formats` has one row for each motivation a `mark` job takes (MarkJobParams), named by it, and `count`, the count a linking job asks of each piece beside its extraction. A request asks for an array of `element`: on an Ollama engine as `format`, `{"type": "array", "items": <element>}` (D1), and on an Anthropic one as `output_config`, `{"format": {"type": "json_schema", "schema": {"type": "array", "items": <element>}}}` (D20), the element written as it is here, member for member. A generation (a `yield` job) asks for no format: its answer is the document.

formats.name: highlighting
formats.about: A highlight: the passage, and up to 64 characters before and after it (K1).

formats.name: commenting
formats.about: A comment: the passage, the comment, and what stands before and after (K2).

formats.name: assessing
formats.about: An assessment: the passage, the assessment, and what stands before and after (K3).

formats.name: linking
formats.about: A mention: the passage, the entity type it is a mention of, and what stands before and after (K4).

formats.name: tagging
formats.about: A passage of the category asked for, and what stands before and after (K7).

formats.name: count
formats.about: The count a linking job asks of a piece beside its extraction: how many mentions of the type it holds (K4).
